title: Deep reconstruction of a Mo-based electrocatalyst for high-performance water/seawater oxidation at ampere-level current density
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1952-1962
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04941A, Paper
Jianpeng Sun, Shuai Zhou, Zhan Zhao, Shiyu Qin, Xiangchao Meng, Chen-Ho Tung, Li-Zhu Wu
A deep reconstructed amorphous FeMoOOH/NF catalyst was designed and characterized, exhibiting low overpotential and high stability in both alkaline aqueous solution and seawater.
